decision_reasons: The current OpenAPI, soccer-hub endpoint table and FAQ say GET /v1/matches/{id}/statistics is Free, but the dedicated Serie A page's plan matrix lists advanced match statistics as starting at Edge. This first-party conflict leaves Free entitlement unresolved.

The Free season-depth documentation conflicts internally: the global pricing page summary says current season, its Free plan bullet says current plus most-recent season, and the dedicated Serie A page says current season only.
The OpenAPI describes aggregation from 19+ free-tier upstream sources and 10 MCP scrapers but does not identify the upstream source or rights chain for each required field.
The published 91.7% team-stat coverage is an older all-seasons aggregate, not current 2026/27 per-fixture or corner/yellow/red field completeness.
No authenticated Free-plan response or match-level schema sample was reviewed; no account, key or provider request was created.

The statistics route is stored-only and post-match, with hourly persistence and an approximate upstream delay of 30 minutes; per-match first-observed and per-field correction timestamp semantics remain undocumented.
Local receipt time and SHA can prove the project possessed exact response bytes before a later quote, but cannot prove upstream first observation or correction history.
Retention after account closure and written upstream field-rights clarification remain unresolved; owner authorization has not been provided.
The offline archive gate now loads the canonical repository rights manifest itself and verifies its exact Git blob SHA-1; callers can no longer pass synthetic approval flags to bypass the HOLD.

endpoint_plan_observations.implication: Free entitlement for required Serie A team statistics is not approved; do not ingest.
